purpose: Describe being made to perform an action.
keywords: Causative passive: ichidan stem + させられる; godan a-stem + せられる, often contracted to a-stem + される; する → させられる; 来る → 来させられる.
As a child, I was made to run every day.
Yesterday I was made to listen to a long explanation.
I was made to eat vegetables I disliked.
formation: Causative passive: ichidan stem + させられる; godan a-stem + せられる, often contracted to a-stem + される; する → させられる; 来る → 来させられる.
restrictions: Often suggests lack of choice; contractions depend on verb class.
mistake: The person forced to act is the subject of the causative passive.
